content.rendered: Please plan to attend the Incoming Freshman Student and Parent night on February 26th. This event will take place in the Sherwood High School gym from 6:30 to 8:30 pm. Please attend with your student.  Please note, the format for this year’s Freshman Parent/Student Night has been revised from previous years.  We strongly encourage you and your student to both attend this event. There will be opportunity to meet in smaller groups with administration/ counselors, get a tour of SHS, and find out more info. about academics and extra-curriculars.
